name: Zro
description: MoonMath's coding-agent API with a free daily allowance that resets every day.
overview: Zro is MoonMath's private inference service aimed at coding agents, and its Free plan costs $0 with "included daily usage" that resets every day. The free plan covers DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3 Flash through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at zro.moonmath.ai/v1, with zero request retention and no training on requests. The dollar amount behind the daily allowance is not published, which is the one thing to check in the console before depending on it. Paid plans start at $20/month for a $40 usage budget.

offer.label: Free daily usage on two Flash models
